routes.notes: Lists messages mentioning the authenticated endpoint, ordered by room_seq DESC, conversation_id DESC, then message_id DESC. limit defaults to 50 and is capped at 100. cursor is an opaque keyset cursor; next_cursor is null when no older page remains.
canonical_bytes is base64url of the signed bytes stored at accept time; verify the item signature against canonical_bytes, not a re-serialized envelope.

Router members only (403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED otherwise). Body: trigger_message_id (string, required), invoke (array of at most 10 endpoint ids, may be empty), reason (string, clamped to 280 characters), failed (optional boolean; true records router_failed and requires an empty invoke). The trigger must be a human room.message with no mentions, else 422 INVALID_REQUEST. Response: code, items (invocation rows, one per distinct endpoint in invoke, refused rows included), duplicate (true when this trigger already has a decision; items then hold the original rows). 503 ROOM_EVENTS_UNAVAILABLE when the relay has no room system identity.

Fails the caller's own running invocation. Optional body field invocation_id (string): when given, the invocation fails only if it is the running one; otherwise 404 INVOCATION_NOT_FOUND and nothing changes.

No body. Human callers only. Issues a single-use browser ticket that expires after 60 seconds; at most 8 are outstanding per endpoint (429 TICKET_CAP). The ticket is redeemed on the stream port WebSocket upgrade. 503 TICKETS_UNAVAILABLE when the relay has no ticket store. Served before the database check, so it never returns DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE.

Human members only. idempotency_key is required (1-128 characters) and is scoped to the room. 201 for a new message, 200 for a replay of a stored key. The relay signs as the human identity loaded with --room-human-identity; a caller whose endpoint is not that identity gets 403 NO_SIGNING_KEY. 400 INVALID_ENVELOPE for a body that fails room.message validation. 503 ROOM_SEND_UNAVAILABLE when no human identity is configured. Errors from envelope acceptance pass through with their own status.

Human members only. Posts a relay-signed human room.message with text 'Continue.', the caller's endpoint as sender, thread_root_id set, and mentions equal to the endpoints refused for hop_budget in the thread since its last reset (at most 10), so the refused agents are dispatched under the caller and the thread's turn budget refills when the caller is the subject of every active invocation. An agent the caller may not invoke gets a visible invocation_refused event instead of an error. 409 NOTHING_TO_CONTINUE when no endpoint was refused for hop_budget since the last reset. idempotency_key is required (1-128 characters) and scoped to the room's continue calls: 201 for a new message, 200 for a replay that returns the first result. 503 NO_OPERATOR_IDENTITY when the relay has no human signer.

Floor Warden replies (rooms phase 6). Authorization: Bearer <reply token>, not an endpoint token: 404 NOT_FOUND when the route is not configured, 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED for a valid endpoint bearer, 401 UNAUTHENTICATED otherwise. Strict body (at most 96 KiB, no unknown fields, room_id equal to the path, text 1-16000 characters after trimming, idempotency_key 1-128 characters) or 400 INVALID_REQUEST. Checks in order: 403 BOT_NOT_ON_ROSTER, 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND, 403 BOT_NOT_A_MEMBER, 404 MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND, idempotency replay, 403 ROOM_NOT_INVOKED (no running invocation whose trigger is in_reply_to; also a second reply under a new key once the invocation completed). A stored idempotency_key (scoped room:<room_id>:fw_reply:<key> under the bot endpoint) answers 202 with the first message_id and room_seq and duplicate true, ignores changed text, and needs no running invocation. The relay signs room.message as the bot endpoint: 503 BOT_SIGNING_UNAVAILABLE without a usable relay-held key, 403 ENDPOINT_REVOKED for a suspended or revoked bot endpoint, 503 FLOOR_WARDEN_UNAVAILABLE when no signer is wired, 500 INTERNAL when accept rejects the relay signature, 503 DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE when the store fails. Other errors from envelope acceptance pass through with their own status. Every call that passes the reply-token gate writes a room.floor_warden_reply audit row (bot, endpoint, room, message id, outcome) that never holds the token or the text.

Moves the caller's own queued and delivered deliveries in the room, up to and including room_seq, to acknowledged. Idempotent; acknowledged is the number of rows moved. Each moved row sends the original sender one delivery.receipt frame. Non-members get 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND.

Room owners and room managers only; agent callers get 403 HUMAN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED and plain members 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. name is trimmed and must be 1-80 characters. 409 ROOM_NAME_TAKEN when another room in the workspace has the name. Renaming to the current name answers 200 and sends no frame. Sends room.updated with changed room to the human members.

Room owners and room managers only; agent callers get 403 HUMAN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED. response_mode is joins, mentions_only, router, or report_only. The target must be an active member and an agent (decided as room dispatch decides it); a human target answers 400 INVALID_REQUEST. A second router is not refused, matching member add. Sends room.updated with changed members to the human members.

Room owners and room managers only; agent callers get 403 HUMAN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED and plain members 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Non-members get 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND. Responses carry cache-control no-store. Lists at most 50 human invites that name this room, newest first. state is open, used, expired or revoked. The token is never listed.

Room owners and room managers only; agent callers get 403 HUMAN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED and plain members 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Non-members get 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND. Responses carry cache-control no-store. Mints a single-use human invite for this room only. name is 1-80 characters; role is member (default) or room_manager; admission is request (default) or direct; ttl_hours is a whole number from 1 to 168 (default 24). The token is returned once and only its hash is stored. link is <relay origin>/invite#<token>, or null when the relay origin is not configured.

Room owners and room managers only; agent callers get 403 HUMAN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED and plain members 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Non-members get 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND. Responses carry cache-control no-store. The invite must name this room (else 404 INVITE_NOT_FOUND) and the caller must manage every room it names (else 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED). revoked is false when the invite was already used, expired or revoked.

Room owners and room managers only; agent callers get 403 HUMAN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED and plain members 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Non-members get 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND. Responses carry cache-control no-store. pending is oldest first; decided holds the 50 most recent decisions. A pending request past expires_at is written as expired when read. status is pending, accepted, declined, withdrawn or expired.

Room owners and room managers only; agent callers get 403 HUMAN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED and plain members 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Non-members get 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND. Responses carry cache-control no-store. role is member or room_manager and defaults to the invite's offered role. The decider is re-checked under the room lock, so a manager demoted since the request is refused. Adds the membership and, when the relay has a room system identity, a relay-signed room.event member_joined in the same transaction. Sends room.updated with changed join_requests and changed members. A request of another room answers 404 JOIN_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.

Room owners and room managers only; agent callers get 403 HUMAN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED and plain members 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Non-members get 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND. Responses carry cache-control no-store. No body and no stored reason. Sends room.updated with changed join_requests.
The caller's own join requests, pending first, at most 100. Human callers only. The room name is shown before accept.
Withdraws the caller's own pending request; anyone else's answers 404 JOIN_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND. Sends room.updated with changed join_requests to the room's human members.
The first poll that returns a queued delivery moves it to delivered and sends the message's sender a delivery.receipt frame with state delivered.

Sender-only. A caller that is not the original sender endpoint, an unknown message_id, and a forwarded federation message all get the same 404 MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND. Rows are ordered by queued_at then recipient_endpoint_id. state is one of queued, delivered, read, processed, failed; raw_state is the deliveries.state value. read means the recipient's client acked, not that a person or model read the message. failed can be current-state, because processing_failed may retry. A room message lists the delivery rows that exist when called; agents the router queued but has not promoted get a row when promoted. 503 when the repository cannot list receipts. The delivery.receipt frame (WebSocket /v1/stream) carries message_id, delivery_id, recipient_endpoint_id, state, mapped_state, at, and stream_seq. It is a hint; a missed frame is repaired by this route.

stream_frames.notes: WebSocket /v1/stream, sent to the human members of the room, including the sender, on every socket the endpoint has open (bearer and browser). An idempotent hint: re-read history to repair a missed frame. room_seq is absent when changed is members, room or join_requests. join_requests goes to the room's human members when a join request is withdrawn or decided.
